import sys; sys.path.insert(0,str(WORK))
from lib7 import *
print([p.name for p in WORK.iterdir() if p.suffix in ('.npz','.npy')])
d=np.load('feats_seq1024.npz')
ids=[f'p{i:04d}' for i in range(1496)]
y=labels_for(ids, practice, LABELS)
M9,C9,M0=[d[k].astype(np.float64) for k in ['mean_hidden_L9','cls_hidden_L9','mean_hidden_L0']]
for c,lam,c0 in [(10,0.02,0.5),(10,0.01,0.5),(10,0.04,0.5),(10,0.02,1.0),(10,0.02,0.25),(20,0.02,0.5),(5,0.02,0.5)]:
    r=[cv(M9,C9,M0,y,c=c,lam=lam,c0=c0,seed=s) for s in range(3)]
    print(c,lam,c0, np.round(r,4), round(np.mean(r),4))
